9.Z08312: the airbag ECU manages deployment of the pyrotechnically pretensioned seat belts and the airbags
9.Z08313: the airbag ECU is installed between the two front seats, at floor level
9.Z00464: the front airbag is a complement to the seat belt, designed to activate in the event of a violent front impact
9.Z00465: its role is to interpose itself between the front occupant(s) of the vehicle and the dashboard, to absorb their projection forward at the time of a violent frontal impact and thus to limit the risk of serious injury to head and chest
9.Z08315: the airbags are not deployed by only a slight front impact, by a rear impact or by the vehicle overturning, as they would not be of use in these instances
9.Z08330: the side airbags are designed to deploy in the event of a substantial lateral impact, but only on the side where the impact occurs
9.Z08333: the side airbags are not designed to deploy when the side collision is only slight, or in the event of a rear or front collision or overturning, as they would not be of use in these instances
9.Z08337: the role of the chest-type side airbag is to insert itself between the driver or passenger and the door panel at chest level
9.Z08338: the chest-type side airbags are incorporated in the outer side wings of the driver's and passenger's seats
9.Z00485: the role of the "curtain airbag" is to interpose itself between the front or rear occupant and the windows
9.Z00487: it thus limits the risks of serious injury to the head
9.Z00488: the curtain airbags are incorporated under the roof trim, on each side of the vehicle
9.Z00489: at the time of a very violent lateral impact, the front airbags may also deploy
